data.title: Product Goal is its own entity: goal.set and goal.closed events
data.why: How a goal ended — achieved or abandoned — is what a Sprint Review needs, and a setting keeps only its last value. One at a time is enforced in the CLI; the fold marks an earlier goal replaced when two branches each set one, so the merge stays visible (I1).
data.rejected: A field on board.configured: last write wins and the outcome history is lost; A milestone: it groups tasks toward a date, a Product Goal is the reason the tasks exist
